preconditions.description: The number of packets n must be between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 1000 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each packet must contain between 1 and 1000 balloons.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (1 <= k <= n and len(set(indices)) == k and all(1 <= i <= n for i in indices))
postconditions.description: If it's impossible to divide the balloons, output -1. Otherwise, output the number of packets k and their indices.

postconditions.expression: sum(a[i-1] for i in indices) != sum(a[j-1] for j in range(1, n+1) if j not in indices)
postconditions.description: The total number of balloons in Grigory's packets must not be equal to the total number of balloons in Andrew's packets.
